title: Dragon Age 2 - Microsoft Xbox 360 CIB EA (Tested)
descriptionText:
Immerse yourself in a world of battle, fantasy, role-playing, and action & adventure with Dragon Age 2 for Microsoft Xbox 360. This complete in box (CIB) game from EA includes a manual and has been tested for quality assurance. 

Join the ranks of those who seek to save the world from destruction and choose your own path through the game with multiple storylines and endings. This game is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and was released in 2011 with a rating of M - Mature. Get ready to embark on an epic journey with Dragon Age 2, the second installment in the popular Dragon Age series.
